title: UnlimitedResponseAsset
description:
An asset with an unlimited license that the organization owns.

The server returns this object in the `unlimitedAssets` array of [GetAssetsResponse](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicemanagement/getassetsresponse) when the `unlimited` query parameter is set to `true`. This object omits the `availableCount`, `totalCount`, and `retiredCount` fields, which don’t apply to unlimited licenses.

adamId.description: The unique identifier for the product in the store.

assignedCount.description: The assigned amount of the asset.

deviceAssignable.description: The flag denoting whether the asset is device-assignable.

pricingParam.description: The quality of the product in the store.

revocable.description: The flag denoting whether the asset is revocable.

supportedPlatforms.description: The platforms that the asset supports.
